    jtest tests/api-*.json
    jtest tests/**/* !tests/obsolete-tests/*

    <test-file-patterns>    List of test file patterns that are executed in     
                            order. Example: "tests/**/*"                        
                            "!tests/obsolete-tests/*"                           

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                 Prints help information                          
        --env-file             File path to environment variables               
    -e, --env                  Environment variable formatted as key=value. You 
                               can specify the option multiple times to define  
                               multiple enviornment variables                   
        --globals-file         File path to global variables                    
    -p, --parallel             Run test files in parallel (default: 1)          
    -o, --output               Output folder path where reports are saved       
                               (default: working directory)                     
    -c, --categories           Comma-separated list of test file categories to  
                               run (default: all)                               
        --skip-output          When specified, then does not output a report    
                               file (default: false)                            
    -f, --output-format        One of the following output formats: 'markdown'  
                               (default: markdown)
